meaningEvidence: Original audio downloaded and full local Albanian ASR reviewed, 0–164.12 seconds; metadata duration 164.77 seconds.
Original poster independently viewed: creator at inscribed monument base with a historical equestrian-monument image inset.
ASR preserves the intended Tirana destination, interpretation of horse/rider, fascist political setting, later commemorations, and closing pride after visits to palace and monument.
limitations: ASR has name/date/number errors; no uncertain line is quoted verbatim.
Weight, number of competing designs, exact payment and military-biography claims are omitted.
The rider’s control is the creator’s interpretation, not an authenticated statement of the sculptor’s intention; city catalogue describes the horse walking.
The 1938 government sources are published reproductions; they establish an intended Tirana project, not physical removal of a statue installed in Tirana.
Municipal inauguration date 27 October and Foreign Ministry archival date 28 October conflict; only October 1940 is asserted.
The full inscription is not transcribed from the incomplete poster; the commemorative date is independently sourced.
Exact filming date is not inferred from the upload date.
